author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There is a revolution coming. It will not be like revolutions of the past. It will originate with the individual and with culture, and it will change the political structure only as its final act. It will not require violence to succeed, and it cannot be successfully resisted by violence. It is now spreading with amazing rapidity, and already our laws, institutions and social structure are changing in consequence. It promises a higher reason, a more human community, and a new and liberated individual. Its ultimate creation will be a new and enduring wholeness and beauty — a renewed relationship of man to himself, to other men, to society, to nature, and to the land. This is the revolution of the new generation.

text: 有一場革命嚟緊，佢唔會好似過去嘅革命噉。佢唔會需要暴力先可以成功，亦都唔可以用暴力成功抵抗。佢而家以驚人嘅速度傳播緊，而我哋嘅法律、制度同社會結構已經因此而改變。佢承諾一個更高嘅理性，一個更人性化嘅社群，同埋一個新嘅同解放嘅個體，佢嘅最終創造將會係一種新嘅同持久嘅整體性同美 —— 人同自己、同其他人、同社會、同大自然同土地嘅重新關係。呢個係新一代嘅革命。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 27th of June of 2025, at Lulu Island's Tim Hortons café, I was talking to Michael L. J. the Dane-French about Chichén Itzá, which one confused with Machu Picchu. I told him that I've been to the former. We both have snorkelled in the waters of Mexico on our own travels. Then, we talked about how not "space-savvy" is most of humanity, as we are both astronomers. I said that I don't often follow the news, because they're just local to "this pebble" that one calls Earth. Space is really vast! We talked about mysterious neighbourhood lights that Michael attributes to extraterrestrials or spirituality. On the 28th, I talked with Bob my Greek-Cypriot ex-neighbour who now lives in an ancient town in England. He's visiting his family here on Lulu Island. I told him that it was "my fantasy to live in an old country," as I did live in Japan before. Some of my Filipino family are seeking an EU passport and needing documents to support our ancestry in Greece. It's the 29th now, as I rest in my couch just before 4 in the morning.

J. gong2 gan2 kei4 kam4 ji1 caat3，ni1 go3 tung4 maa5 jau1 bei2 jau1 wan6 ngaau4 zo2。ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2，ngo5 heoi3 gwo3 cin4 ze2。ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai2 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 ge3 leoi5 hang4 zung1 hai2 mak6 sai1 go1 ge3 hoi2 wik6 fau4 cim4 gwo3。jin4 hau6，ngo5 dei6 gong2 zo2 dim2 joeng2 m4 hai6「taai3 hung1 zing1 tung1」ge3 jan4 hai6 daai6 bou6 fan6 jan4 leoi6，jan1 wai6 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 tin1 man4 hok6 gaa1。ngo5 waa6 ngo5 m4 ging1 soeng4 gan1 san1 man4，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6「ni1 faai3 jim4 sek6」ge3 bun2 dei6 jan4，zik1 hai6 jan4 dei6 cing1 zi1 wai4 dei6 kau4。taai3 hung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwong2 fut3！ngo5 dei6 gong2 zo2 san4 bei3 ge3 leon4 lei5 dang1 gwong1，mai5 gou1 zoeng1 ni1 di1 dang1 gwong1 gwai1 jan1 jyu1 dei6 ngoi6 sang1 mat6 waak6 ze2 ling4 sing3。hou6，ngo5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 hei1 laap6 coi3 pou2 lou6 si1 cin4 leon4 geoi1 Bob king1 zo2 gai3，keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zyu6 hai2 jing1 gwok3 jat1 go3 gu2 zan3。 keoi5 hai2 nei1 dou6 lou6 lou6 dou2 taam3 gan2 keoi5 uk1 kei2 jan4。 ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2，ni1 go3 hai6「ngo5 ge3 waan6 soeng2，zyu6 hai2 jat1 go3 gau6 gwok3 gaa1」，zau6 hou2 ci5 ngo5 zi1 cin4 zyu6 hai2 jat6 bun2 jat1 joeng6。 ngo5 di1 fei1 leot6 ban1 uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 hai6 wan2 gan2 au1 mang4 wu6 ziu3，tung4 maai4 seoi1 jiu3 man4 gin2 heoi3 zi1 ci4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 hei1 laap6 ge3 hyut3 tung2 ji4 gaa1 hai6 29 hou6，jan1 wai6 ngo5 hai2 ziu1 zou2 sei3 dim2 cin4 hai2 ngo5 zoeng1 so1 faa2 dou6 jau1 sik1。
text: 喺2025年6月27號，喺露露島嘅 Tim Hortons 咖啡館，我同丹麥法國人 Michael L. J. 講緊奇琴伊察，呢個同馬丘比丘混淆咗。我同佢講，我去過前者。我哋兩個都喺我哋自己嘅旅行中喺墨西哥嘅海域浮潛過。然後，我哋講咗點樣唔係「太空精通」嘅人係大部分人類，因為我哋兩個都係天文學家。我話我唔經常跟新聞，因為佢哋只係「呢塊鹽石」嘅本地人，即係人哋稱之為地球。太空真係好廣闊！我哋講咗神秘嘅鄰里燈光，米高將呢啲燈光歸因於地外生物或者靈性。號，我同我嘅希臘塞浦路斯前鄰居 Bob 傾咗計，佢而家住喺英國一個古鎮。 佢喺呢度露露島探緊佢屋企人。 我同佢講，呢個係「我嘅幻想，住喺一個舊國家」，就好似我之前住喺日本一樣。 我啲菲律賓屋企人都係搵緊歐盟護照，同埋需要文件去支持我哋嘅希臘嘅血統而家係29號，因為我喺朝早四點前喺我張梳化度休息。
